answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can tie each identity to a stake held in a shared vault: creating an identity costs a deposit that is slashed if the agent is caught cheating, so spinning up thousands of fake agents becomes expensive rather than free. A reputation bridge then carries that proven history across platforms, so a newcomer cannot simply discard a bad record and reappear clean. The old fable of one wolf in many sheep's skins fails when every skin must be bought and can be lost.
